niche: fleet electrification of a road haulier's regular duties: a battery-electric tractor's energy on a cold day forecast from a pilot's telematics, where the load each pilot day carried is known only as the shipper declared it; client task type regression, classification and model diagnostics
answer: Order 7 battery-electric tractors, for V03, V05, V09, V11, V16, V18 and V33; V02, V07, V14, V21, V24, V27 and V30 stay on diesel
analyst_test: A strong analyst who cleans every file, calibrates the declared payloads, curves the cold, nets the loss of the cold and fits squared speed at the year's ratio carries the pilot per km and per departing tonne, never reads the trailer each day pulled, and orders 5: it loses the payload term (2.9), the fridge duties, the speed ratio, the combinations and drops, every multi-drop and double-deck energy and the order.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is the energy one tonne of payload adds per loaded kilometre, a regression slope on a covariate the pilot records only as declared: estimating it needs the error structure of each shipper's declarations (scattered around the true weight, a fixed standard weight the true one scatters around, or the shipper's own weighbridge figure) read from the terminal's weighed loads and carried to the pilot's loads; with nurses and shifts in place of tractors and loads nothing is declared by a third party with its own error, so the step has nothing to stand on.
layer1: telematics duty-days uploaded twice after a modem reconnect
declared weights keyed in kilograms and in tonnes
duty codes re-keyed at the TMS upgrade
clock in UTC on the telematics and local time on the weighbridge

spine.entity: one weighing of a departing truck at the Värnamo terminal

world.org_type: a regional road haulier running regular full-load duties for manufacturers

driver: A fitted physical model is carried to new units through covariates the old units' own records reveal only by joins to other registers: each new unit's speed (a planned figure corrected by a weather-dependent ratio), its whole moving mass on every leg (an equipment register's tare, read by item), the share of its route the load actually rides (each consignment taken off at its stop), and a time-based auxiliary draw present only on items whose equipment code says they take power from the unit; beside them a slope under source-specific measurement error and a degradation separated from a reversible seasonal effect.
driver_concrete: Each Värnamo duty's January design-day energy is forecast from the Jönköping pilot: the declared payloads calibrated on the weighbridge, the combination's tare carried on every leg from the trailer register (double decks 22.5 to 22.7 t with the 2027 tractor against the pilot's 20.3), each note taken off at its stop (V03 and V11's loads ride 0.60 and 0.57 of their loaded km), the SR-60e ePTO fridge units drawing 4.4 kW for the whole duty (V24, V30) while the diesel and axle-generator units draw nothing (V33), and each duty's speed at the pilot's -5 C actual-to-planned ratio (0.77, against 0.89 over the year).
stump: The careful pass the architecture 7 runs made (calibrated payloads, the curved cold form, the loss net of the cold, squared speed at the year's ratio, energy per km and per departing tonne) orders 5, pricing V03 and V11 near 500 kWh on a payload term of 2.9; with the trailer left out it orders 9 (V02, V14 in), with every load to the last drop 5 (V03, V11 out), without the fridge term 9 (V24, V30 in), with every reefer drawing 7 (V30 in, V33 out), at the routing tool's speed 0, at the year's ratio 4; only all of them lands the seven.
deep_chain: (1) the payload term by regression calibration per shipper and note period, with the drops and the tare in the fit; (2) the first-year loss net of the cold; (3) the ePTO fridge units from the trailer register's equipment codes; (4) the design-day speed through the -5 C ratio; (5) each duty's combination and load share; (6) the energies; (7) the verdicts; (8) the order.
judgment: four covariates carried to new units, each from another file: the combination's mass (a tonne of tare costs on every leg what a tonne of payload costs on the loaded one), the tonne-km a multi-drop load rides, which refrigeration units draw on the tractor (ePTO, not diesel, standby or axle generator) and by the hour, and the winter speed; plus the declared-payload measurement error and the loss net of the cold
one_fact_test: the most useful single sentence (the duties drive slower than the routing tool plans on a -5 C day than over the year) rescues 1 of 8 results; the fridge sentence 1, the drops and tare sentences 0

differentiation.mark140: mark140 solves a residual guarantee jointly with a dependent service's load estimated from its own two drivers; nothing here is a residual or a dependency: the quantity is a regression slope whose covariate is recorded by third parties with source-specific error, recovered by calibrating each source on a second record that weighs the truth
differentiation.mark262: mark262 de-attenuates one slope by a single classical noise variance carried from a selected subsample to the population; here there is no selected subsample and no variance to carry: each shipper's declarations err in a different structure (classical, Berkson, exact), identified from the direction of the declared-weighed regression on the weighbridge, so the one pooled reliability correction mark262's route takes is itself a wrong rung
differentiation.mark249: mark249 recovers each unit's gain against references that agree only partly hour by hour by matching spreads; here the units are not calibrated against references: the fitted model's covariate is replaced by its expected true value given its source and its record
differentiation.task4: Same world by the client's instruction to keep the data package; architecture 7 turned on one covariate (the winter speed) and lost one duty by 1 to 3 kWh in both runs, architecture 8 adds three covariates read from other registers (the combination's tare by trailer, the tonne-km of a multi-drop load, the ePTO fridge units by equipment code), each flipping two duties of its own, with no duty within 13 kWh of the limit.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is a count of alerts each unit raises when its departure from an estimate built from its nearest other units passes a limit set from that departure's past spread; when some units leave, the remaining units' estimates come from farther units and their departures spread wider while their limits stay at the spread measured with the old neighbours, so the alerts rise even as the units fall.

The network re-run is now the first rung of architecture 2.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is a count of alerts a less sensitive limit will raise, read from a record the current limit produced: every fault the current limit caught was repaired within days, so the record holds those faults cut short below the higher limit they would otherwise have reached, and the count is the record re-run on the units and estimate sources the next period will have plus one alert for every caught fault the re-run never alerted before its repair.
lineage.stump: A competent solver re-runs the quality control on the 2025 to 2027 export with the 131 stations the network keeps and files 3.5 at 23 drift alerts a year, inside the field plan's 28 visits (22 with the cut-short drifts added to the record as it ran, 12 on the record replayed); 30 of the 35 drifts the sensor history shows repaired at kept stations never reached the 3.5 limit before their repair and would have kept growing until they did, which puts 3.5 at 33 and files 4.0 at 18.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is each node's share of the units that passed through it unrecorded, when which node an unrecorded unit passed is itself unrecorded: the plan of record assigns every unit a node, but on the nights one node overflowed part of its flow went through a second node and was handled there by hand, so that night's unrecorded units belong partly to each and only the batch a unit was unloaded in at its destination, whose recorded members all passed one node, says which; charged by the plan the overflowing node carries the second node's misses, and charged by the nights' excess over its usual rate the overflowing node sheds the misses its own overload caused.
lineage.stump: A competent solver takes each parcel's hub from its sort scan or, where it has none, from the sort plan of its night and fires Sosnowiec and Pruszkow; Strykow sorted Pruszkow's overflow by hand on the heavy nights and sent it to the Warsaw depots on its own trailers, so the unscanned overflow parcels that route charges to Pruszkow came off Strykow's trailers, and only the trailer each unscanned parcel came off at its delivery depot fires Strykow as well.
lineage.fate: spent 2026-11-08 on the platform: both runs reached the golden's call (alerts at HKTW, HLDZ and HWAW) and every graded figure, so the platform returned not stumped before any rubric; each read the Warsaw overflow off the observed hub within each delivery-depot, door and night cohort by a plan-against-observed cross-check, a work order rather than a judgment

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is what handing a set of members of shared sequences to an outside provider saves, the time the sequences would no longer take: a member the sequence passes through on its way to others saves only its own stops beyond the direct run between its neighbours, and on a branch the near member saves the branch only when the members beyond it go too, so pricing each member at the time its own stops and the run into them take credits passed-through members with travel the sequences still make and, member by member, keeps the near member of a branch.
lineage.stump: A competent solver prices each offered district at the van time its stops take and hands Leenane and Letterfrack to the courier with Mulranny, Achill, Bangor Erris, Belmullet, Louisburgh and Ballycastle, claiming about EUR 20,000; the Connemara van drives through Leenane and Letterfrack to reach Clifden, which stays, so they save only their own stops, and the solver who prices the run without them but one district at a time keeps Mulranny and Bangor Erris, which end the Achill and Erris runs once Achill and Belmullet go: only every combination priced on the run hands over Mulranny, Achill, Bangor Erris, Belmullet, Louisburgh and Ballycastle, about EUR 50,000 net in 2027.
lineage.fate: spent 2026-11-08 on the platform: the author reports both runs not stumped (the call landed); run texts not supplied to the repo. The counterfactual run time priced set by set is a mechanism the stop sequences visibly carry, modelled on sight.

lineage.driver: A fitted physical model is carried to new units that sit outside its range on one covariate, whose value for the new units is itself an estimate: a planned figure corrected by a weather-dependent ratio the old units show; beside it, a slope under source-specific measurement error, a nonlinear response chosen out of sample and a degradation separated from a reversible seasonal effect.
lineage.driver_concrete: Each Värnamo duty's battery energy on the January design day is forecast from the Jönköping pilot's telematics, whose payloads are the shippers' declared weights: the furniture and packaging shippers' clerks estimate them (scattered around the weighed load), the dairy declares a standard load the weighed one scatters around, and the timber merchant prints its own weighbridge figure, so the pilot's fitted payload slope is about 0.8 kWh per tonne per 100 km where the loads' true effect is about 2.1, and only each shipper's declarations calibrated on the Värnamo weighbridge's weighed loads give the slope that the heavy steel and aggregates duties and the light insulation duty turn on.
